title: 1.9.2: Key Equations
originalText:
Key Equations

            Constant function	
            \(f(x)=c,\) where \(c\) is a constant	

            Identity function	
            \(f(x)=x\)	

            Absolute value function	
            \(f(x)=|x|\)	

            Quadratic function	
            \(f(x)={x}^{2}\)	

            Cubic function	
            \(f(x)={x}^{3}\)	

            Reciprocal function	
            \(f(x)=\frac{1}{x}\)	

            Reciprocal squared function	
            \(f(x)=\frac{1}{{x}^{2}}\)	

            Square root function	
            \(f(x)=\sqrt{x}\)	

            Cube root function	
            \(f(x)=\sqrt[3]{x}\)	

            Average rate of change	
            \(\frac{Δy}{Δx}=\frac{f({x}_{2})−f({x}_{1})}{{x}_{2}−{x}_{1}}\)	

            Composite function	
            \((f∘g)(x)=f(g(x))\)	

            Vertical shift	
            \(g(x)=f(x)+k\) (up for \(k>0\) )	

            Horizontal shift	
            \(g(x)=f(x−h)\) (right for \(h>0\) )	

            Vertical reflection	
            \(g(x)=−f(x)\)	

            Horizontal reflection	
            \(g(x)=f(−x)\)	

            Vertical stretch	
            \(g(x)=af(x)\) ( \(a>1\) )	

            Vertical compression	
            \(g(x)=af(x)\) \((0<a<1)\)	

            Horizontal stretch	
            \(g(x)=f(bx)\) \((0<b<1)\)	

            Horizontal compression	
            \(g(x)=f(bx)\) ( \(b>1\) )
